title: Fix the Incomplete Interface Implementation
description: The program should have a class implement a Payable interface's method fully.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print the freelancer's pay.
actualProblem: Freelancer implements Payable but never provides a body for calculatePay(). Since Freelancer isn't declared abstract, the compiler rejects it: 'Freelancer is not abstract and does not override abstract method calculatePay() in Payable'.
explanation: A non-abstract class that implements an interface must provide a concrete implementation for every abstract method the interface declares, or the compiler will refuse to accept it as complete.
